insight_templates.title: The delivery system may be overloaded
insight_templates.insight: Work appears to be entering the delivery system faster than teams can realistically complete it.
insight_templates.explanation: When work intake consistently exceeds delivery capacity, delivery pressure increases and predictability becomes difficult.
insight_templates.direction: Exploring how work enters the system may help restore sustainable delivery flow.

insight_templates.title: Delivery may be operating as a work intake system
insight_templates.insight: Work appears to be entering delivery faster than it can be prioritised for value.
insight_templates.explanation: When product ownership is weak and backlog volatility is high, teams often shift into responding to incoming work rather than shaping value delivery.
insight_templates.direction: Strengthening product ownership may help reconnect delivery decisions with value.

insight_templates.title: Delivery may be slowed by organisational friction
insight_templates.insight: Decisions and responsibilities may not currently flow smoothly through the delivery system.
insight_templates.explanation: When decision authority is unclear or centralised, teams often experience delays while waiting for direction.
insight_templates.direction: Exploring how decision authority is shared may help improve delivery flow.

insight_templates.title: Delivery expectations may not align with system reality
insight_templates.insight: Leadership expectations and delivery system behaviour may not currently align.
insight_templates.explanation: When expectations exceed the system's current capabilities, teams experience pressure while delivery stability declines.
insight_templates.direction: Reviewing expectations alongside delivery constraints may help rebalance the system.

insight_templates.title: Delivery output appears unstable
insight_templates.insight: Delivery output varies significantly between iterations.
insight_templates.explanation: High delivery variance often indicates interruptions, shifting priorities, or system constraints.
insight_templates.direction: Stabilising how work flows through the system may improve predictability.

insight_templates.title: The backlog may contain more work than the team can deliver
insight_templates.insight: The backlog currently appears larger than the team's delivery capacity.
insight_templates.explanation: When backlog size grows beyond realistic delivery capacity, prioritisation becomes difficult and delivery pressure increases.
insight_templates.direction: Reducing backlog size or clarifying priorities may improve focus.

insight_templates.title: Work may be sitting in the backlog too long
insight_templates.insight: Some backlog items appear to remain unaddressed for extended periods.
insight_templates.explanation: Older backlog items can indicate unclear priorities or excessive backlog size.
insight_templates.direction: Reviewing backlog freshness may help maintain a healthy delivery pipeline.

insight_templates.title: Psychological safety may be limited
insight_templates.insight: Team members may not feel fully comfortable raising concerns or challenging ideas.
insight_templates.explanation: Strong delivery environments rely on open communication and constructive challenge.
insight_templates.direction: Encouraging open discussion may strengthen team learning and collaboration.

insight_templates.title: Collaboration across the team may be limited
insight_templates.insight: Work may currently be organised in ways that reduce collaboration.
insight_templates.explanation: When collaboration is limited, delivery often slows and knowledge silos emerge.
insight_templates.direction: Exploring how work is shared across the team may strengthen collaboration.

insight_templates.title: Team ownership appears to be developing
insight_templates.insight: Teams are beginning to take greater responsibility for delivery decisions.
insight_templates.explanation: Growing ownership often creates opportunities for stronger collaboration and learning.
insight_templates.direction: Supporting teams in shaping delivery decisions may strengthen ownership further.

insight_templates.title: Trust within the delivery system appears to be growing
insight_templates.insight: Leaders appear to be gradually increasing decision authority within teams.
insight_templates.explanation: Trust between leadership and teams enables faster and more adaptive delivery decisions.
insight_templates.direction: Continuing to expand decision autonomy may strengthen delivery flow.

insight_templates.title: Delivery flow appears stable
insight_templates.insight: Delivery output appears predictable and consistent.
insight_templates.explanation: Stable delivery flow enables teams to plan improvements and deliver value more reliably.
insight_templates.direction: Maintaining this stability creates a strong foundation for continuous improvement.

insight_templates.title: Teams appear to demonstrate strong ownership
insight_templates.insight: Teams actively influence delivery decisions and backlog direction.
insight_templates.explanation: Strong ownership enables teams to respond quickly to delivery challenges.
insight_templates.direction: Encouraging this ownership can further strengthen delivery outcomes.

insight_templates.title: The team environment appears supportive
insight_templates.insight: Collaboration, learning, and open communication appear strong.
insight_templates.explanation: Supportive team environments enable continuous improvement and resilient delivery.
insight_templates.direction: Maintaining this environment can help sustain delivery effectiveness.
